---
title: "Render smoke test"
---

Not part of the site: files starting with `_` are excluded from project renders.
Render it on demand to check the whole option-A path end to end:

```
cd blog && uv run quarto render _smoke.qmd
```

It passes when the study is importable, the artifacts are present, and the UMAP
stack loads in this environment.

```{python}
import sys; sys.path.insert(0, ".")
from _study import ARTIFACTS, ROSTER, STUDY, artifact, metrics, plots

print("study     :", STUDY)
print("artifacts :", ARTIFACTS, "->", "ok" if ARTIFACTS.is_dir() else "MISSING")
print("roster    :", ROSTER)
print("plots     :", [n for n in dir(plots) if n.startswith("plot") or n == "index_plot"])
print("metrics   :", [n for n in dir(metrics) if n in {"compare", "score", "join_truth", "add_horizon"}])

import umap
print("umap      :", umap.__version__)

import numpy, polars, pyarrow, matplotlib
print("numpy     :", numpy.__version__, "(must be 1.x)")
print("pyarrow   :", pyarrow.__version__, "(must be 25.x)")
print("polars    :", polars.__version__)
print("matplotlib:", matplotlib.__version__)
```

```{python}
#| fig-cap: "The study's figure style, applied in the blog environment."
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 2.4))
ax.plot(np.arange(28), np.random.default_rng(42).poisson(0.45, 28))
ax.set_title("style check - not data")
ax.set_xlabel("day")
plt.show()
```
